purpose: Record the owner's change of direction (both blocked rows become executable via controlled reconstruction) and freeze the two reconstruction contracts BEFORE any training.
authority: OWNER_APPROVED DIRECTION for E04-2 and E07c-4 (both OPTION B, controlled reconstruction), plus owner authorization to reconstruct missing pieces as close to the papers and official code as reasonably possible. The M6A5a Option-A recommendation was ADVISORY ONLY and is superseded.
reconstruction_hierarchy: 1. Preserve exact paper equations and losses whenever specified.
2. Preserve exact official architecture/code whenever available.
4. Preserve published training budget and optimizer behavior.
5. For missing scientific components, choose the nearest reproducible substitute performing the SAME FUNCTION.
6. Freeze every substitute and newly introduced parameter BEFORE training.
7. Do not tune substitutes using TEST.
8. Do not choose substitutes based on which one makes GPAT look better.

controlled_adaptation_components.original_requirement: 3DMM fitting via the paper's [61] Dense Face Alignment over the Basel Face Model
controlled_adaptation_components.unavailable_artifact: BFM (registration-gated; version not identifiable from the paper); [61] is MATLAB/MatConvNet test-only
controlled_adaptation_components.rationale: Performs the paper's exact function (3DMM fit -> dense mesh), same BFM model family as [61], ships its own official depth renderer and its own 68 iBUG correspondence, deterministic, fixed topology. Licence position is recorded factually in M6A5_TDDFA_ASSET_PROVENANCE.json; this benchmark offers no independent legal interpretation.
controlled_adaptation_components.expected_scientific_difference: Fitted shape differs in detail from the authors' [61] fit (different regressor, BFM derivative, 40/10 basis dims). The function - a pose-aligned dense facial surface - is preserved.

controlled_adaptation_components.unavailable_artifact: exact indices never published (only the count and a qualitative rationale)
controlled_adaptation_components.substitute: deterministic 140-vertex coverage set: 68 model-native iBUG anchor vertices + 72 farthest-point-sampling picks over the canonical neutral mesh, inside the convex hull of the anchors
controlled_adaptation_components.rationale: Algorithmic, documented, reproducible, image-independent, TEST-independent, never visually cherry-picked. Seeding with the 68 semantic landmarks preserves the correspondence the paper's sparse->dense Delaunay warping (Eq. 14-16) actually requires; FPS supplies the stated face-region coverage.
controlled_adaptation_components.expected_scientific_difference: A different but equally dense and semantically anchored vertex set; warping-field detail will differ from the authors' unpublished selection.

controlled_adaptation_components.original_requirement: render the depth ground truth M0 from the fitted 3D shape
controlled_adaptation_components.unavailable_artifact: the rendering procedure is never described; the published Algorithm 1 takes M0 as a pre-computed INPUT
controlled_adaptation_components.substitute: official 3DDFA_V2 depth semantics (z-buffer visible surface; per-sample min-max z normalisation to [0,1]; background 0) rendered in the canonical 256 frame, then INTER_AREA resize to 32x32 and clip to [0,1]
controlled_adaptation_components.rationale: The depth semantics are taken from an authoritative implementation (utils/depth.py + Sim3DR), not invented. Only the working frame, the stored mask, the resize rule and the final clip are benchmark-defined, and each reuses an already-frozen benchmark convention.
controlled_adaptation_components.expected_scientific_difference: Absolute depth values will differ from the authors' renderer; the relative facial-surface structure and the [0,1] range required by the paper are preserved.
controlled_adaptation_components.paper_derived_not_substituted: Spoof M0 = all-zeros 32x32 (Eq. 21, verbatim). K=32. L1 loss form. alpha_1=100 and all published coefficients unchanged. L_depth is NOT removed.

controlled_adaptation_components.original_requirement: 17-way attack classification on PADISI-USC via ImageFolder
controlled_adaptation_components.unavailable_artifact: released PADISI.pkl weights; the PADISI-USC dataset; the 17-class directory->label mapping
controlled_adaptation_components.substitute: K=7 attack-macro classification over the frozen benchmark taxonomy (live, makeup, mask_2d, mask_3d, partial, print, replay), frozen TRAIN split only
controlled_adaptation_components.rationale: Nearest attack-category classification supported by the frozen ontology; preserves the MULTICLASS conditioning intent that binary live/spoof would destroy; deterministic mapping from frozen metadata with no invented label. Critically, unet_autoenc DISCARDS the 4th encoder output, so the class count changes ONLY the discarded head - the consumed feature interface is shape-identical.
controlled_adaptation_components.expected_scientific_difference: Different image domain and 7 rather than 17 categories, so the learned conditioning space differs from the authors'; class imbalance is more pronounced. The function - an attack-category-discriminative multi-scale feature extractor - is preserved.
controlled_adaptation_components.architecture_note: The encoder ARCHITECTURE is NOT substituted: the repository's own custom_rn.resnet18 ([3,4,6,3] ResNet-34 topology) is used, not torchvision resnet18.

E04: canonical 256 working frame (reuses frozen M2 geometry frame)
256->32 INTER_AREA resize (reuses frozen preprocess_v1 downscale rule)

disclosed_interaction: The E07c substitute label space is also the ArtifactProbeNet taxonomy used for the ArtSim metric. Separate models, no shared weights, no TEST - so not leakage - but aligning E07c's conditioning to the ArtSim taxonomy could in principle favour E07c on that metric. Disclosed because it advantages the BASELINE, not GPAT.

authority_vs_derivation.owner_approved_direction: controlled reconstruction for E04 and E07c
authority_vs_derivation.note: Values tagged PAPER/OFFICIAL come from the publications or the official repositories; everything tagged BENCHMARK is this benchmark's own derivation, made after the owner authorized the direction.

distinction.auxiliary_encoder_training_seed: 42, fixed; seeds the one-off pretraining of the substitute conditioning encoder
distinction.e07c_experiment_seed: 42 / 1337 / 2026; seeds each DiffFAS main training run

e07c_auxiliary_encoder_seed_contract.scientific_rationale: Most closely reproduces the role of the unavailable original PADISI.pkl, which would have been ONE fixed external pretrained asset shared across DiffFAS runs, not an asset retrained per experiment seed.

fidelity_rationale.E01: Official FAS-Aug transformation/operator behaviour is preserved. The M6A3 owner-approved lexicographic asset enumeration replaces host-dependent os.listdir ordering SOLELY for reproducibility. This is NOT a controlled scientific adaptation.
fidelity_rationale.E02: Frequency Substitution is defined directly by frozen spec 8.2. It is NOT an adaptation of an external paper/repository method; M6A3 merely completed spec-silent execution details (rounding, RNG, seed namespace).
fidelity_rationale.E03: Official STDN code path at the pinned commit; no method-changing adaptation.
fidelity_rationale.E04: Geometry/depth reconstruction under owner-authorized controlled reconstruction (A3 section 4).
fidelity_rationale.E05: PCGAN architecture resolution to the pinned [34] executable base (A2-07); retained unchanged.
fidelity_rationale.E06c: E06c is NOT native or faithful DSDG: Amendment A1 explicitly adapts DSDG to BIN-IDFREE semantics (DEV-020). The prior phrase 'A1 adaptation semantics' is provenance, not a fidelity class.
fidelity_rationale.E07c: A1 adapts DiffFAS to BIN-IDFREE semantics (DEV-021); A3 adds the controlled conditioning-encoder reconstruction. Both layers are recorded.
